name: OSS_MANUAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENTS
description: Following tabel is used to capture manual price adjustment

columns.name: MANUAL_PRICE_ADJ_ID
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture unique indentifier of manual price adjustment

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture sequence number of manual price adjustment

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture adjustment value of manual price adjustment

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CURRENCY
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture adjustment currency of manual price adjustment

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture price periodicity of manual price adjustment

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture reason of manual price adjustment

columns.name: VALID_FROM
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture valid from time of manual price adjustment

columns.name: VALID_UNTIL
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture valid until time of manual price adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_PARENT_ENTITY
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture charge parent entity of manual price adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_PARENT_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture charge parent entity id of manual price adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture charge rollup flag of manual price adjustment

columns.name: PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture price adjustment type of manual price adjustment

columns.name: PRICE_BASIS_ELEMENT
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture price basis element of manual price adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture charge definition of manual price adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Following filed is used to capture charge definition id of manual price adjustment

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PERIODS
columns.description: Number of time periods to use for the price adjustment

columns.name: PERIODIC_TYPE
columns.description: Abbreviation that identifies the type of periodic adjustment to apply. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type ORA_OSS_PRICE_ADJ_EFFECTIVITY

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM
columns.description: Number that identifies the period when the price adjustment starts

columns.name: PERIOD_TO
columns.description: Number that identifies the period when the price adjustment ends

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
